A grocery store you can rely on

Olat Everyday Essentials stocks the foodstuff, groceries, provisions and drinks Ilaro families buy every week. We keep prices fair, keep the shelves full and keep the store easy to reach at Bim Junction.

Planning an event or a gift? We also pack foodstuff, build hampers and prepare branded souvenirs, so one stop covers the whole job.

Questions

Quick answers before you call.

Where is the store?

Bim Junction, Ilaro, Ogun State.

How do I place an order?

Build your list on this page and tap "Send order as PDF on WhatsApp". You can also call 08107205281 or 09073604092.

Can you make a hamper for an event?

Yes. Share your budget and the occasion and we will curate and pack it.

Do you do branded foodstuff and souvenirs?

Yes. Message us with your quantity and branding details so we can quote you.

Your shopping list

Fill in your details and list. We turn it into a neat PDF order slip with our logo and send it on WhatsApp.

Start each line with the quantity, for example 3 x Semovita.

On a phone, choose WhatsApp from the share list and open the Olat chat. On a computer the PDF downloads and WhatsApp opens, so attach the PDF there.
